scope: Twelve selected unresolved high-impact questions from existing YouTube research; not additional roadmap tasks

blockers.required_to_measure: Deduplicated active people over a defined global monthly window
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Ad reach and surveys are not world MAU

blockers.required_to_measure: Dated uploader event cohort including vanished and zero-subscriber channels
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Indexed channels and net video counts do not identify active human creators

blockers.required_to_measure: Consented receipts, expenses, all labor and zero earners
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Official monetization rules cannot establish realized profit

blockers.required_to_measure: Matched niche video census or weighted watch-time panel
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Omdia platform-wide watch-time share is not niche competition

blockers.required_to_measure: Representatively sampled consented joint viewer-country/language statistics
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Video locale and viewing geography cannot infer personal language ability

blockers.required_to_measure: Eligible made-for-kids creator statements and matched ad-view denominators
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Ads not personalized does not mean ads forbidden or fixed loss
Public views and average percentage are not full completion of people

blockers.required_to_measure: Compatible published survey-wave uncertainty and design comparisons
blockers.invalid_shortcut: A one-point difference of rounded Pew estimates is not a tested decline

blockers.required_to_measure: Matched eligible creator receipts and view measurements
blockers.invalid_shortcut: User-entered interval calculations are not observed revenue
Public subscriber totals cannot show viewing subscription state

blockers.required_to_measure: Opt-in matched migration cohorts and consistent source/destination counts
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Media copying or CSV export does not move native followers

blockers.required_to_measure: True creator-start cohort with right censoring and repeat observations
blockers.invalid_shortcut: Upload pauses and zero net count are not verified permanent exit

principles: A protocol's existence does not imply observed data
Private or minor user records must not be obtained without authorization and protections
Do not declare empirical completeness when evidence is absent
